title: SC11-T1 — the text (SH01, SH02, SH03)
line: Two weeks later, Peter texted me. First time in four years. I read it, I smiled, and I put my phone away.
motionPlan: Michelle sits at the patio table with a cup of coffee; her phone (a little smaller than her hand) lights up on the table → the phone (a little smaller than her hand) on the mosaic table lights up with a message; her hand picks it up → Michelle's mouth curves up at one corner as she sets the phone (a little smaller than her hand) face down on the table, then lifts her coffee
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
